name: How long does a typical whole-house window replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical whole-house window replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole-house window replacement project varies based on the number of windows, the type of windows being installed, and the complexity of the installation. For an average-sized home in the Bay Area, the installation itself can typically be completed within 3 to 5 days. However, the entire process, from initial consultation and material ordering to final installation, may span several weeks or even a few months, depending on lead times for custom windows and scheduling.
